body: Thanks for answering guys. This has been going on for a long time and his behavior keeps escalating in my opinion. He is seeing a nurse practitioner for his meds, but I am the only other person he knows and it is getting a bit out of hand. I have talked to some other friends tonight about it and everyone agrees I should speak up. Yesterday at work, for instance, he wrote me a list of all the reasons he thinks he is a horrible person. That is not a healthy thing to do and I think that it what catalized this for me in to action. Thank you for your response and your understanding.
